title: Cursor testimonial grid
description: A centred 36px heading over a 3×2 grid of paper quote cards 10px apart: the quote in 16px ink at the top, and pinned to the bottom a 40px round avatar with the person's name and their role in 60% ink. Phones show the first three cards in one column, each quote cut to four lines.
notes: six quotes fill the grid; phones show three, tablets two columns of all
